# Academic Journey

## Research profile

I am an interdisciplinary biochemist with 4+ years of research experience spanning mass spectrometry, bioanalytical method development, molecular biology and cell-based assays. My current work combines plant molecular biology, genome editing, metabolic engineering and analytical chemistry to investigate sunflower lipid metabolism.

My research direction is toward integrating mass spectrometry-based lipidomics with spatial and molecular approaches to understand lipid metabolic heterogeneity in complex biological systems.

## M.Sc. dissertation

**Isolation of Fluoride-Resistant Microorganisms from Fluoride-Contaminated Groundwater and Evaluation of Their Bioremediation Potential**

The dissertation investigated fluoride-resistant microorganisms from groundwater in Nalgonda. Ten locations were analysed; the highest fluoride concentration observed was 9.18 ppm. Three strains tolerated up to 500 mg/L NaF, with strain MB1 achieving 68% fluoride removal under the tested batch conditions.

## Academic direction

My long-term aim is to build an interdisciplinary research career connecting plant biotechnology, lipid metabolism, analytical instrumentation, molecular profiling and computational biology.
